title: POST /v0.1/spheres/{sphere}/invitations request
description: Admin only. Named: one Obi of one owner (`owner` and `obi`), used once. Open: neither, used by up to `max_uses` Obis whose cards name their own `obi_id` and `owner`, and, with `domain`, only by people who sign in with that Google Workspace (spec/sphere-api.md section 4).

max_uses.description: An open invitation only: how many Obis may join with it. 1 when left out.

domain.description: An open invitation only: each redeem carries a sign-in from an account of this domain.

label.description: For the admins' own list (`GET …/invitations`): a few words, never an email address. The Sphere keeps no address (section 3.1).
